programme.title: Andromeda: Lava og raketter
programme.desc: Dylan overtager en turistbåd i et forsøg på at undslippe lejesoldaterne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Alle mine synder skal huskes
programme.desc: En identifikation af et lig går galt, da det viser sig, at Bekas tidligere besætningsmedlem ikke er død.

programme.title: Andromeda: Enfluernes dans
programme.desc: Andromeda redder døende mennesker fra en drivkraft, men de bliver snart til zombier, der styres af et hive-mind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himlen er der nu tre
programme.desc: Skaberens motor er i stand til at omskrive universet efter ejerens ønsker. Dylan, Beka og Trance må få fat i den, før nogen med mørke planer får fat i den.
programme.sub-title: I himlen er der nu tre

programme.title: Andromeda: Det, vi ikke kan ændre
programme.desc: Et sort hul slår Dylan ud og sender ham ind i en alternativ virkelighed med kone og barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den skønne ukendte
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en af de længe forsvundne grundlæggere af Commonwealth, men opdager, at hun måske er mere besværlig, end hun er værd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Udyrets mave
programme.desc: Et mytologisk rumuhyre forsøger at æde Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ridderen, døden og djævelen
programme.desc: Dylan forsøger at befri en flåde af tilfangetagne skibe, men flåden er ikke sikker på, at den ønsker at blive befriet. Deres AI'er frygter, at nye kaptajner vil gøre dem til slaver.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubesmittet opfattelse
programme.desc: Genitter angriber Tyrs kone og koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunnelen for enden af lyset
programme.desc: Med halvtreds parter om bord er Dylan vært for underskrivelsen af det nye rigsfællesskabs charter, men opdager snart, at der er ubudne gæster, der har til hensigt at stoppe underskrivelsen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvis hjulet er fastgjort
programme.desc: Beka og Tyr bliver overtaget af energien fra en dimensionstunnel. Dylan, Trance og Harper må redde dem, før de ødelægger skibet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skår
programme.desc: Dylan bliver anklaget for mord og skal rense sit navn, mens han finder delene af en vase, der siges at give ejeren "kosmos velsignelser

programme.title: Andromeda: Gal for at blive reddet
programme.desc: Besætningen redder en gruppe flygtninge, men opdager, at de har været udsat for regeringens eksperimenter og er ekstremt ustabile.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Beka's onkel stiller op til et embede i det nye Commonwealth, men et mordforsøg får besætningen til at agere som hans sikkerhed.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det ensomme og jævne sand
programme.desc: Da Andromeda bliver angrebet af pirater i rummet, bliver de reddet af et længe forsvundet rumskib fra Jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Krigshundene Slipfighter
programme.desc: Besætningen opdager, at en slyngelplanet, Marduk, har fremstillet masseødelæggelsesvåben.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den spedalskes kys
programme.desc: En lejemorder ved navn Leper er ude efter lederne af det nye Commonwealth.

programme.title: Andromeda: For Whom the Bell Tolls
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver hjemsøgt af et mystisk væsen, der kommer om bord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Andromeda: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programme.desc: Da en længe savnet kærlighed vender tilbage, forsvinder Tyr fra skibet for at beskytte hende mod en lejemorder.
programme.sub-title: And Your Heart Will Fly Away

programme.title: Andromeda: Den uovervindelige mand
programme.desc: Spiller i et alternativt univers, hvor Dylan er død, og Gaheris Rhade forsøger at reformere Commonwealth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Guarded Secrets
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoking Out a Killer
programme.desc: A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath used by students to walk from one side of campus to the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Frozen Assets
programme.desc: In 2004, Mary Ann Clibbery was found brutally murdered at her Illinois business. Investigators had to determine if this was a robbery gone wrong or a calculated murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoot to Thrill
programme.desc: In 2003, St. Cloud teenager Jason MacLennan returned home after a night out with friends and discovered his father's body lying in a pool of blood.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Political Thriller
programme.desc: In 2006, Nevada politician Kathy Augustine died mysteriously during a re-election campaign. The medical examiner could neither isolate the cause of death, nor explain the tiny puncture wounds discovered during the autopsy.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Double Cross
programme.desc: In 1996, Virginia Beach police arrive at the Makdessi apartment to find the bloodied bodies of Elise Makdessi and Navy sailor Quincy Brown. But was Brown Elise's lover or her assailant?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dancing with the Devil
programme.desc: In 1999, Patrick McRae was found dead in his Des Moines home and the crime scene was awash with blood. Analysis showed it had come from two people, one of whom was female.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Dance
programme.desc: In 2000, the body of exotic dancer Rachel Siani was found beneath a New Jersey bridge. Investigators wondered if she had committed suicide. They discovered that Rachel offered to assist a drunk customer named John "Jack" Denofa to his motel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Constructive Criticism
programme.desc: In 2000, construction manager Darrell North was found dead in his work trailer in Ft. Worth, Texas. When investigators arrived, they found that he had been stabbed 46 times, indicating a personal relationship between the victim and the attacker.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Hidden Obsessions
programme.desc: In San Diego, California, a killer has left behind pieces of evidence. Detectives must sort through these small clues to prove murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blind Trust
programme.desc: A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows
programme.desc: A woman is found dead at the bottom of the basement stairs. As detectives look into the accident, they begin to question the sequence of events.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Impressions
programme.desc: 911 receives a desperate call in Fort Worth, Texas. A man's wife is shot. Forensic investigators search for clues in unlikely places, hoping the victim herself could provide information needed to determine how and why she died.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Misplaced Loyalty
programme.desc: In Northern California, a fire rages in the middle of the night. A woman's charred body is discovered in the smoldering aftermath.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Killing Time
programme.desc: A killer may strike in the middle of the night, and hide clues well. But the police are always there, ready and working, and they will never give up when they're on the trail of criminals who decide it's Killing Time.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out To Kill
programme.desc: An abandoned car outside Philadelphia brings heartbreak to a family and terror to a community. A young woman is dead, the killer gone. But the marks of his passage remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Trust
programme.desc: A New York homebuyer gets more than he bargained for when a house inspection turns up a mummified corpse. For decades, the crime had gone undiscovered. The victim unmissed, and the killer unpunished.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: IFISH: Mulloway - Botany Bay, NSW
programme.desc: Ever wondered why Captain Cook chose to first land on the southern banks of Botany Bay on Sunday 29th April 1770? Because the fishing is so hot! The fish were coming in so thick and fast the boys had to take a break...

programme.title: Anglers Digest: St. Lucia
programme.desc: You’ll join us on an informative island tour of volcanoes, waterfalls, gardens, and scenic viewpoints, and even get a chance to party with the friendly natives that are lucky enough to call this paradise their home.

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Curaçao
programme.desc: This episode includes a great island tour where you’ll explore the island history, the natural scenic splendors, and a city tour of Willemstad, all of which will make you strongly consider a trip here in the future.

programme.desc: IGFA Anglers Digest returns to Grand Cayman to fish and dive in this secluded piece of paradise. Known the world over for its world class scuba diving, those who really know the island come to fish as well.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars
programme.desc: Mars has fired our imagination for thousands of years. The tantilizing possibility of life has made it the most inviting planet in our solar system. It is the only other place that man may one day call home.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: Den ikoniske vennegruppe begynder på en frisk, da de vender tilbage til The Hills og ses for første gang i flere år. Der er nye udfordringer, gamle rivaliseringer og romantiske forviklinger da de indser, at fortiden ikke altid er fortiden.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Are We Exclusive?
programme.desc: Kaitlynn & Brodys 'A-liste-galla skaber splid i gruppen, da hun ekskluderer visse medlemmer. Audrina overrasker alle ved at genantænde et forhold til en gammel flamme. Spencer chokerer Heidi med en overdådig overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: This Hangover Better Be Expensive
programme.desc: Brody og Kaitlynn har stadig problemer i forholdet, da de besøger en fertilitetslæge. Heidi og Spencer forbereder sig på at forny deres løfter med konkurrerende polterabends. Brandon har svært ved at definere sit nye forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.sub-title: Brody Gets Away with So Much

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Of Course We're Married
programme.desc: Spencer konfronterer Brody med hans ægteskabsstatus og sandheden afsløres. Brandon træffer en endelig beslutning om sit forhold til Ashley. Whitney deler en følelsesladet nyhed med Kaitlynn.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: What You Missed
programme.desc: Denne timelange special ser tilbage på familiefejderne, venneforræderierne og andre øjeblikke fra denne sæson af New Beginnings.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Burying The Past
programme.desc: Efter næsten et år samles gruppen igen for at begrave stridsøksen og starte på en frisk. Brody forsøger slutte fred med Kaitlynn efter deres brud.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Best Friends Kissing
programme.desc: Brody og Audrina er begge i nye forhold, og Brandon er klar til at gå videre med sit forhold. Heidi og Spencer kæmper for at udvide familien og har brug for at lette trykket. Jason og Ashley får en livsændrende nyhed.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: The Last Hurrah
programme.desc: Gruppens ferie tager en drejning, da Kaitlynn uventt møder Brodys nye flamme. Brandons håb om en romantisk rejse med Dani bliver bragt i fare efter en stor karrierefejl, og en uventet forbindelse blomstrer.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Who's a Better Kisser
programme.desc: Brody og Heidis venskab står ved en skillevej, da middagen ender i et skænderi. Mens Brody overvejer, om Amber er den rette for ham, efterlader Audrinas første kys med Sean hende kun med flere spørgsmål. Justin åbner op over for gruppen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You Told Her?!
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencer er chokerede over at finde ud af, at deres adfærd er blevet et diskussionsemne. Audrina skal træffe en beslutning om både Brody og Sean; og Caroline gør sine sande følelser for Kaitlynn klart.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I'm Back in LA Bitches!
programme.desc: Slænget fejrer Kristin Cavallaris besøg i LA. Spændingerne vokser mellem Heidi & Audrina. Justin & Jason styrker deres venskab. En god nat bliver til en god morgen, da Brody og Audrina endelig sætter deres kemi på prøve.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: "Who Slept at Your House?"
programme.desc: Da Kristin udspørger Brody om hans "sleepover" med Audrina, svirrer rygterne, og Kaitlynn føler sig udenfor. Caroline konfronterer Kaitlynn over deres venskab, der ligger på is, og Jason hører, at Spencer sætter spørgsmålstegn ved hans ædruelighed.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Get Dessert and Bail
programme.desc: Brody og Audrinas flirt tager fart. Krigen mellem familien Pratt og Wahler når kogepunktet, mens Brandon er ude i kulden efter Danis kølige svar til, om de skal flytte sammen. Audrina og Heidis venskab står ved en skillevej.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Time Heals Not Some Things
programme.desc: Heidi og Spencer søger hjælp til deres skrantende økonomi. Mens Kaitlynns nye forhold stadig trives, truer en flirt fra Brandons fortid forholdet til Dani. Justin forsones med sin far efter en svær tid.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: That's Math Right There
programme.desc: Kaitlynns beslutning om at flytte sammen med sin fyr får alle til at undre sig over, hvad der foregår. Heidi & Spencer er bekymrede for deres firma, og mens Brandon revurderer sit forhold, indser Audrina nogle ting om Brody.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Party Foul
programme.desc: Paulie og Lexi får omsider defineret deres forhold, men Hemmelighedshullet truer med at ødelægge deres tid i paradiset. En ny eks kommer for at gøre en gammel eks jaloux og stormer festen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Monster Mode
programme.desc: Jasmine er fristet til at bringe en ny mand ind og smide en anden ud. Da Alicia angriber Cory, bliver alle indblandet. Forhold står på spil, når ekserne bringer deres plads i huset i fare.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: You Can't Handle the Truth
programme.desc: Cory og Taylors forhold kommer i farezonen, da Corys følelser for Alicia kommer frem i lyset. En kommentar udløser et stort skænderi. En ny eks kommer og får en uventet nyhed.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Return of all the Exes
programme.desc: Huset går i chok, da de eliminerede ekser vender tilbage. Et spil kvit eller dobbelt er uskyldigt, indtil Angela og Derrick gør noget dumt. Huset omgrupperer sig efter det store skænderi.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?
programme.desc: En tur til SOS truer med at splitte et genforenet par. Chases kærlighedstrekant går op i en spids. Singlerne må beslutte, om de vil forlade Hawaii med kærlighed eller solo.
programme.sub-title: Can You Ever Get Over Your Ex?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Paige og Sam
programme.desc: Paige vil ikke fastsætte en bryllupsdato, før hun taber sig, og Sam vil få muskler for at slå igennem som model. Kan de forvandle sig i tide til at vise sig frem i Ex on the Beach?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Jourdan og Liam
programme.desc: Jourdan vil tabe sig for at få sin Beyoncé-facon tilbage, og Bertram vil få muskler for at slå igennem som skuespiller. Kan de forvandle sig i tide til at vise sig frem i Ex on the Beach?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Deano og Paris
programme.desc: Deano er desperat efter at slippe af med dellerne og se lige så muskuløs ud som sine venner, så han kan begynde at date. Paris vil få styr på sine former og få sin selvtillid tilbage. Opnår de en forvandling før deres store Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Becci og Kieran
programme.desc: Becci er træk af at være den tykke søster og vil tabe sig. Kieran er træt af at være en splejs og vil have muskler. Kan de forvandle deres kroppe i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Ronan og Camilla
programme.desc: Ronan har taget en masse kilo på og er nede over det, mens Camilla vil tabe sig før sin pigeferie. Når de at forandre deres liv i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Shelbie og Liv & Vanessa
programme.desc: Vennerne Shelbie & Liv har tager voldsomt på og trænger til at tabe sig. Vanessa drømmer om at få en krop som en kvindelig bryder. Kan de forvandle deres kroppe i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Mahan og Lydia
programme.desc: Pizzeria-ejeren Mahan har spist for meget dej og vil af med dellerne, mens Lydia vil have sin gamle krop tilbage. Kan de forvandle sig i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Sheena og Georgia
programme.desc: Sheena har brug for at tabe sig til sin bryllupsrejse, og Georgia vil tage sig for at blive, som hun var før. Kan de nå at ændre deres liv i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Middagsdates med eks som tilbehør.
programme.desc: De single kendisser mødes til et poolparty og kaster sig ud i romantik. Men da terrortabletten siger, de skal have intime middagsdates, får de et chok over, at en eks ryger ud første aften.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Taget på sengen
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet for Finn & Paige. Kendisserne fester på en strandklub, men Ashley kommer i tvivl om sit forhold til Jarred, og en stor kendis-ankomst tager Yaz på sengen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Jeg er smuttet
programme.desc: Yaz, Chloe og Brockett får sig en snak. Finn og Paige har svært ved at bo sammen. En ny eks ryster et par ind til grunden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kærlighed med bump på vejen
programme.desc: Chloe, Veitch og Finn bliver tættere, og det er svært for Paige. Der er problemer i Yaz Chloe Brocketts venskab og en overraskende eks' ankomst truer med at ødelægge et par.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Løve-eksen
programme.desc: Chloe Veitch befinder i et trekantsdrama. Yaz Chloe Brockett venskab går fuldstændig galt, bådfesten bliver rystet af en eks på jetski, og tre kendisser bliver sendt på stranden, hvor den næste eks gemmer sig i mørket.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Aftenstranden
programme.desc: Kan Lockie og Yaz finde ud af at bo sammen? Chloe lægger alle sine æg i en kurv og en djævelsk flot kendis ryster villaen, men hvem ryger hjem nu?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Den eneste vej er eks
programme.desc: To ekser bliver elimineret, og James bliver knust. Yaz og Lockie prøver en sidste gang at slutte fred. En kendiseks laver ravage og villaen siger farvel til en OG.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Tale of Two Players
programme.desc: Audrey bliver paranoid, da hun ser Michael skabe kontakt til Geles. Malcolm får ballade, fordi han er en player, og huset begynder at udforske nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: No Love in Nola
programme.desc: Jalousi kommer i centrum til en vild Mardi Gras-fest. Geles bliver fjende nummer et, da hun bager på flere fyre i huset. Dimitri provokerer Jada.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Love by the Numbers
programme.desc: Tyler vil gerne ud af venneboblen med Nicole. Shad viser nogle følelser. Der er knuste hjerter og jalousi i huset, og de beder Keith om at finde en vinderstrategi.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Den sidste parceremoni nærmer sig hastigt, så huset er desperat for at få de rigtige par ind i sandhedsbåsen og finde de 11 rigtige par. Keith og Alexis presser hinanden lige til bristepunktet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One
programme.desc: Vært Terrence J giver os et eksklusivt kig på denne sæsons medvirkende i AYTO og afslører, hvorfor de 22 singler er elendige til forhold.
programme.sub-title: I've Got 99 Problems Cuz I Can't Find the One

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 1
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion The Final Matchup Part 2
programme.desc: Efter at have søgt efter kærlighed i flere uger og spillet for penge, genforenes de medvirkende i sæson 6 for at give insiderviden om eksplosive hændelser og fortælle om uset dramatik og afsløre, hvad der er sket, efter de har forladt huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Leap of Fate
programme.desc: 22 singler tager springet og flytter ind i et hus på Hawaii for at prøve at finde 11 perfekte par og vinde en million dollar. Jalousi spreder sig, når par dannes hurtigt.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Flirt at Your Own Risk
programme.desc: Zak provokerer Bria, når han flirter med andre kvinder, og hele huset bliver inddraget i dramaet. Tevin og Kenyas letsindige opførsel truer deres spirande forhold.

programme.title: Are You The One?: With Frenemies Like These...
programme.desc: Zak udforsker sine muligheder, mens kvinderne slås om hans opmærksomhed. Kenya og Jasmine bliver officielt fjender.

programme.title: Are You The One?: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name
programme.desc: Asia bliver såret, når hun finder ud af, hvad hendes ven og fyren, hun er vild med, gjorde bag hendes ryg. Cali og Bretts spirende romance bringes i fare af deres dårlige vaner.
programme.sub-title: A Boyfriend by Any Other Name

programme.title: Are You The One?: Ex-tracurricular Activities
programme.desc: Huset bliver rystet, da deres ekser dukker op for at få noget kvalitetstid. Bølgerne går højt, når en eks truer med at splitte et stærkt par ad. Zak er splittet mellem Bria og Morgan.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Spilling The Tea
programme.desc: Kwasi starter drama, da han afslører, hvad Tevin og Jasmine gjorde natten før. Bria bliver sur over Morgan og Zaks forhold. Huset tager nogle risikable parvalg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: He Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Cam begynder at tvivle på sit forhold til Kayla. Daniels små lege skubber Sam væk. Huset oplever deres vigtigste sandhedsbås indtil nu.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beast Mode
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt mellem Cam og Kwasi, da Kwasi lægger an på Kayla. Asia eksploderer, da hun tror, at nogle folk i huset er falske. Zak må træffe et valg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: I Want You To Want Me
programme.desc: Nutsa er vild med Brett, men det får konsekvenser for hele huset, at Brett ikke kan glemme Cali. Moe bliver presset til at spille spillet, og Lewis afslører sine sande følelser for Asia.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Want Me

programme.title: Are You The One?: Master Plan
programme.desc: Brias besættelse af Zak truer husets evne til at spille spillet. Cali finder på en plan, der skal afsløre, hvilke magtpar, der er perfekte sammen, og hvem der ikke er.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time
programme.desc: Til en vild fest gør tvivlsom opførsel bedste venner til fjender. Tevin og Kenya gør sig klar til at få opklaret deres skæbne. Moe bliver presset til at tage sig sammen.
programme.sub-title: Once Upon a Crazy Party Time

programme.title: Are You The One?: Caught On Kiss Cam
programme.desc: Kwasi og Jasmines forhold bliver bragt i fare, når en velkendt fjende komme lidt for tæt på. Magtpar prøver at skabe nye forbindelser.

programme.title: Are You The One?: This is Nuts-a
programme.desc: Brett kommer i den varme stol, da han tvivler på sine følelser for Nutsa. Huset kommer i krise, da de prøver at hitte ud af de perfekte par.

programme.title: Are You The One?: It All Comes Down To This
programme.desc: Asia forsøger at ødelægge Sams forhold til Daniel. Huset får en sidste chance for at vinde kærlighed og penge og en ekstra dag til at bringe orden i tingene.
programme.sub-title: It All Comes Down To This

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Juryen
programme.desc: Bestsellerforfatteren John Grisham har endnu engang spundet et net, der fastholder sit publikum iet jerngreb. Sammen med sin advokat sagsøger enken til ofret for en meningsløs...

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: 'Gold' er historien om Kenny Wells, som har kærlighed og venner, men som bliver ved med at jage drømmen om rigdom. Han sælger sine sidste ejendele og rejser sammen med en geolog ind i Borneos dybeste jungle for at lede efter guld.

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: A Philadelphia sound-effects man witnesses and records a car accident that turns out to be a politically motivated murder.

programme.title: A Most Violent Year
programme.desc: In 1981 NYC, an immigrant (Oscar Isaac) and his family try to expand their business as rampant violence and corruption drag them in and threaten to destroy all they have built.

programme.title: Alle ved det
programme.desc: Oscar-vinderne Penélope Cruz og Javier Bardem spiller hovedrollerne i dobbelt-Oscar-vinder Asghar Farhadis intense drama, der udspiller sig i en idyllisk landsby lidt uden for Madrid. Her samles familiemedlemmer fra nær og fjern til stor fest.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Da den håbløse romantiker Wallace møder Chantry, har de kemi med det samme. Der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste. De beslutter sig for at ses som venner, men det bliver sværere og sværere at holde venskabet og de voksende følelser adskilt.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: Down To You
programme.desc: Fra det øjeblik de mødes i universitetets kaos i New York City, begynder Al (Freddie Prinze Jr.) og Imogen (Julia Stiles) deres romantiske rejse, hvor ægte kærlighed ofte konkurrer med fristelsen til at vige fra engagementet.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad har en udmærket karriere og lever et komfortabelt liv sammen med sin hustru og søn, men hans gamle venners liv virker mere glamourøst og rigt. Da han genoptager kontakten med dem, kommer han dog til at tvivle på, hvem der lever det gode liv.

programme.title: Rough Stuff
programme.desc: En aktivistgruppe, der i gang med at lave en film for at afsløre et mineselskabs lyssky aktiviteter, indgår en aftale med nogle anløbne typer fra den australske vildmark. Situationen spidser til, da det viser sig, at begge grupper har en skjult dagsorden

programme.title: Highlander: Endgame
programme.desc: To verdener mødes, når stjernen fra HIGHLANDER, Christopher Lambert, slår sig sammen med Tv-stjernen fra HIGHLANDER, Adrian Paul for at bekæmpe en frygtindgydende skurk og hans flok skånselsløse udødelige.

programme.title: Black Eagle
programme.desc: Et af det amerikanske flyvevåbens mest moderne fly, et F-111 med et helt nyt laserstyresystem, styrter ned i hav ud for Malta. Sovjetisk tilstedeværelse i området gør, at CIA sender deres bedste agent for at bjærge styresystemet.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: Velkommen til Sin City - byen, som tiltrækker de seje, de korrupte og dem med et knust hjerte. Nogle kalder den mørk og hårdkogt, mens skurkagtige betjente, sexede kvinder og desperate selvtægtsmænd kalder den for deres hjem.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brutal Abduction
programme.desc: A Chicago street gang thought they had figured out how to kidnap people for ransom again and again, and never get caught. But their one mistake was they underestimated the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Radical Agenda
programme.desc: In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: My Better Halves
programme.desc: Kriminalforfatteren Charles har skriveblokering. I jagten på inspiration beder han spiritisten Madame Arcati lave en seance. Det fører til mere end forventet, da Madame Arcati fremmaner genfærdet af Charles' kone, Elvira, der vil genoptage sit liv.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad har en udmærket karriere og lever et komfortabelt liv sammen med sin hustru og søn, men hans gamle venners liv virker mere glamourøst og rigt. Da han genoptager kontakten med dem, kommer han dog til at tvivle på, hvem der lever det gode liv.

programme.title: Broken English
programme.desc: Nora Wilder er ved at miste håbet. Alle i hendes nærhed er i et forhold, er gifte eller har børn. Nora er i 30-årsalderen, alene med et arbejde hun ikke trives med, og en mor der konstant babler løs.

programme.title: Can You Keep a Secret?
programme.desc: I den tro at de er ved at styrte ned, fortæller Emma alle sine hemmeligheder til en flot, men vildfremmed mand om bord på et fly. Det vil sige, hun troede, at han var fremmed… Filmen er baseret på bestsellerromanen af samme navn fra Sophie Kinsella.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: To af de skæve forfattere af Scary Movie sætter nu deres parodiske syn på den største genre af dem alle: Hollywoods store budget, special effects-ladede, blockbuster franchise-film.

programme.title: Også engle spiser bønner
programme.desc: Charlie er fribryder i forbudstidens New York, og han nægter at være med til at fikse en kamp, og gangsterbossen Angelo har satset penge på modstanderen. Han bliver nødt til at flygte, og under flugten støder han på Sonny, der også er på flugt.

programme.title: A Christmas Feast
programme.desc: Det er jul, og familien Oliverio gør sig klar til De Syv Fiskes Middag, en italiensk madtradition. Tony, en ung mand med store drømme og et endnu større hjerte, er med i forberedelserne og spekulerer på, om han mon vil finde kærligheden denne jul

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Næsten 20 år efter, at TV-kultserien Galaxy Quest blev stoppet, beder en race af rumvæsner holdet fra serien om hjælp til at redde universet.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: On April 27, 2007, Gaëlle Fosset was found dead in her small house in Saint-Germain-la-Campagne in Normandy.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Eerie Case of the Watcher
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane take a look at the case of the Watcher, a mysterious stalker who terrorized his neighborhood.
programme.sub-title: The Eerie Case of the Watcher

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Scandal comes to a quiet, blue-collar Texan town when its shady mayor is accused of murdering a prominent businessman.

programme.title: Exhibit A: The Frankenstein of Sleep
programme.desc: A man drives 20 minutes along a super-highway and then murders his mother-in-law, allegedly while sleepwalking. Can a sleep expert determine if this is a bogus defense?

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Detectives are determined to do whatever it takes to catch a criminally charged sex offender and murderer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Elements Of Murder
programme.desc: There are several things that can suggest murder; jealousy, anger, poison. When everyday substances reveal hidden clues that break a homicide case, those substances become the elements of murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Their Father, The Godfather
programme.desc: In an exclusive interview, and for the first time, three of the children of the late crime boss John Gotti discuss the life they experienced growing up as members of his family, how they were sheltered from an awareness of Gotti’s lifestyle.

programme.title: Tourist Police: Thailand
programme.desc: We head east and join the Thai police as more tourists are in trouble.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Six Feet Under
programme.desc: In a Toronto suburb during the summer of 1996, a man leaves home for a business trip. He doesn’t return. Fearing foul play, his desperate wife finally reports her husband’s disappearance to the police.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Once a prosperous silver mining camp, Aspen evolved into a year-round mountain retreat for the rich and famous. It was a place where the powerful could forget the hustle and bustle of their hectic lives.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Sins & Secrets
programme.desc: In 2008, Jim Cannon, a prominent attorney and father of three, is found dead in his Nashville mansion. Jim was well known for his promiscuity with other women and even men.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: The case of Shelley Mook, a young mother and Tennessee school teacher who mysteriously vanished after visiting her ex-husband, is examined.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Britain: Garry Newlove
programme.desc: Garry Newlove’s wife Helen talks about the events on the night of his murder and the days afterwards, as well as her current work as a peer in the House of Lords combatting anti-social behaviour.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Death of the Somerton Man / The Horrifying Unsolved Slaughter at Hinterkaifeck Farm
programme.desc: Ryan and Brent delve into the Somerton Man, a farm slaughter, a hotel murder and the deaths of nine hikers.
programme.sub-title: The Mysterious Death of the Somerton Man / The Horrifying Unsolved Slaughter at Hinterkaifeck Farm

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: Notorious Criminals
programme.desc: A 1995 bombing in the heartland destroyed 16 blocks of downtown Oklahoma City.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Kidnapped

programme.title: South Park: Hvide mennesker sætter huse i stand
programme.desc: Randy forholder sig til, hvad det indebærer at være hvid i dagens samfund.
programme.sub-title: Hvide mennesker sætter huse i stand

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion rejser sig
programme.desc: Ført an af 'Mysterion', arbejder 'Coon' og hans venner med at hjælpe folk i Golfen. Og 'Coon' er ude efter hævn.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman bliver lykkelig over at opdage, at han kan sige, hvad han vil til hvem han vil ved at forgive at have Tourettes. Det landsdækkende tv dukker naturligvis op.

programme.title: South Park: Lad dem spise klisterstads
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om, at den nye plantebaserede menu på skolen har givet ham et hjerteanfald.

programme.title: South Park: Pragtsvinet mod Danmark
programme.desc: Pragtsvinet vil ikke længere være præsident.

programme.title: South Park: Sexchikane-panda
programme.desc: Cartman sagsøger Stan for seksuel chikane.

programme.title: South Park: W.T.F.
programme.desc: Efter at have set deres første live WWE wrestling-kamp beslutter drengene at danne deres eget wrestlingforbund og får en stor fanskare af rednecks!

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: South Park er invaderet af arbejdere fra fremtiden, som tager alle job for en lavere betaling. Mændene i South Park griber til usædvanlige midler for at standse dem.

programme.title: South Park: Tolerancens dødskamp
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison vender tilbage til lærergerningen for at erstatte Mr. Hat, og drengene bliver sendt til Tolerancens Dødskamp.

programme.title: South Park: En dreng og en præst
programme.desc: Et meget specielt forhold udvikler sig mellem Butters og den lokale præst. Da byens indbyggere kommer hen til en lukket kirke, og de to venner er forsvundet, tilkalder de den katolske kirke.

programme.title: South Park: Uopfyldt
programme.desc: South Park bliver valgt til at huse Amazons nyeste logistikcenter.

programme.title: South Park: Danser med smølfer
programme.desc: Cartmans får endelig et sted, hvor han kan komme af med sin galde, da han bliver udnævnt til oplæser på skolen, og han udnytter selvfølgelig situationen.

programme.title: South Park: Giv slip, regering
programme.desc: Cartman infiltrerer NSA for at afsløre dem og bliver ikke glad for at se, hvad han finder i sin egen mappe.

programme.title: South Park: Grå daggry
programme.desc: De ældre indbyggere bliver tvunget til at indlevere deres kørekort efter at have forårsaget kaos i gaderne. Stans bedstefar tilkalder AARP for at hjælpe pensionisterne.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 2
programme.desc: Regeringen holder Stan og Kyle i fangenskab og vil ikke frigive dem, før de afslører, hvordan de kom ind i Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Obama vinder!
programme.desc: Eric Cartman gemmer noget på sit værelse, der kan ændre udfaldet af præsidentvalget.

programme.title: South Park: Mit fremtidige mig
programme.desc: En 32-årig mand ankommer til South Park og påstår, at han er Stan fra fremtiden, og Cartman går ind i hævnbranchen.

programme.title: South Park: Verdensomspændende blokfløjtekoncert
programme.desc: Klassen skal opføre en blokfløjtekoncert i Mr. Garrisons hjemby i Arkansas, hvor de forsøger at finde 'den brune lyd'.

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper ikke
programme.desc: Cartman mener, at han er den bedste online-restaurantanmelder i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Hummel-figurer & heroin
programme.desc: Elskede entertainere dør i deres bedste levetid på grund af overdoser. Stan er ved at blive afsløret som kilden til de ulovlige stoffer.

programme.title: South Park: Gratis hat
programme.desc: Drengene tager en sag til sig, da de indser, at deres yndlingsfilm bliver forbedret, genudgivet og ødelagt i processen.

programme.title: South Park: Forkrøblet sommer
programme.desc: Jimmy er på lejr med sine handikappede venner, og det går ikke op for ham, at Nathan prøver at myrde ham. Drengene arrangerer en intervention, når Towelies stofmisbrug bliver for meget.

programme.title: South Park: Kun for medlemmer
programme.desc: Den nyvalgte præsident besøger sin hjemby.

programme.title: South Park: Læg den væk
programme.desc: Nordkorea har South Park i sigtekornet.

programme.title: South Park: Bebes bryster ødelægger samfundet
programme.desc: Bebe er den første pige i fjerde, der 'udvikler sig', hvilket truer drengenes venskab og samfundet generelt.

programme.title: South Park: Kinaproblemer
programme.desc: Foruroliget af de olympiske ceremoniers storhed, beder Cartmann Butters om hjælp til at konfrontere kineserne. Samtidig er Stan og Kyle vidne til 'voldtægten' af Indianan Jones.

programme.title: South Park: Børnekidnapning er ikke sjovt
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at beskytte deres børn fra kidnappere, hyrer forældrene ejeren af City Wok for at bygge den Kinesiske Mur i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Tilbage til rødderne
programme.desc: Butters begynder en rejse, der skal følge i sporene på hans hawaiianske forfædre.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julebæen
programme.desc: Borgmesteren beslutter at indføre et neutralt helligdagstema, som ikke kan fornærme nogen. Kyle mener, at han har svaret.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør
programme.desc: Kenny bliver dødeligt syg, og stakkels Stan har svært ved at klare det.

programme.title: South Park: Chef går bananas
programme.desc: Chef erklærer, at South Parks flag er racistisk. Stan og Kyle leder den gruppe, der støtter det nuværende flag, mens Wendy og Cartman slutter sig til dem, som går ind for et nyt flag.

programme.title: South Park: Scooterne
programme.desc: Børnene vil bruge det seneste i transportmidler for at få mere slik til Halloween end nogensinde før.

programme.title: South Park: En History Channel-thanksgiving
programme.desc: Da drengene prøver at lære alt om Thanksgiving ved at se History Channel, bliver de rodet ind i et mysterium der involverer aliens, Natalie Portman og indmad!

programme.title: South Park: The Worldwide Privacy Tour
programme.desc: Prinsen af Canada og hans kone forsøger at beskytte deres privatliv i en lille bjergby.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Garrisons fine nye skede
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison får omsider en kønsskifteoperation, og Kyle får en ret 'ualmindelig' operation, der skal gøre ham atletisk og høj nok til at spille på basketballholdet.

programme.title: South Park: Fiskefingre
programme.desc: Jimmy er vred over, at Cartman prøver at tage æren for en joke, som han fandt på, der nu er blevet populær i hele landet. Men en vred Kanye West kan ikke forstå pointen.

programme.title: South Park: Surt for Cartman
programme.desc: Butters bliver sendt til en speciel lejr for 'Pray the Gay Away', efter han er blevet grebet i en kompromitterende situation med Cartman. Cartman prøver at få fat i et billede af situationen.
